Projector Throw Calculator

Multiply your projector's throw ratio (or zoom range) by screen width to get the exact throw-distance range in feet and metres.

–

–

–
Screen width

Throw distance = throw ratio × screen width. Leave the max ratio blank for a fixed-lens (single-ratio) projector.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your screen size (16:9 diagonal) or type the screen width directly.
  2. Enter the projector's throw ratio, or the min/max of its zoom range.
  3. Read the throw distance (or range) in feet and metres for mounting.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is throw ratio?

Throw ratio = throw distance ÷ screen width. A 1.5:1 projector must sit 1.5 × the screen width away — for a 100-inch-wide screen that is 150 inches.

How do I use the min/max distance range?

The shortest throw ratio in the zoom range gives the closest mounting position; the longest gives the farthest. Mount the projector between those distances and use zoom to fine-tune.

Can I enter screen width directly?

Yes — the tool derives width from a 16:9 diagonal, or you can type the screen width directly if you know it.
